# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IterativeTDDRunner | src/agents/iterative_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates the full RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple iterations |
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner.py | Runs one complete TDD cycle with GREEN retries and learning loop |
| IncrementalPlanner | src/agents/incremental_planner.py | Determines the next test increment using LLM and playbook context |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent.py | Generates code (test, implementation, refactor) via LLM prompts |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod.py | Executes Python TDD phases in a Podman container, handles file I/O |
| LanguagePod | src/agents/language_pod.py | Protocol for language-specific TDD execution pods |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src/agents/podman_orchestrator.py | Stateless sidecar for container pulse execution and security checks |
| PodmanRunner | src/agents/podman_runner.py | Rootless Podman container lifecycle and pulse execution |
| ContainerRunner | src/agents/podman_orchestrator.py | Abstract interface for container runners |
| PlaybookManager | src/playbook/manager.py | Core playbook CRUD, delta updates, deduplication, and persistence |
| ExperimentLogger | src/storage/experiment_logger.py | Logs TDD/ML experiments to PostgreSQL or SQLite fallback |
| Reflector | src/core/reflector/module.py | Analyzes task outcomes, extracts error patterns, key insights |
| Curator | src/core/curator/module.py | Synthesizes reflector insights into playbook delta bullets |
| Generator | src/core/generator/module.py | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM with bullet retrieval |
| BulletRetriever | src/playbook/retrieval.py | Hybrid retrieval (semantic + keyword) of relevant playbook bullets |
| AdaptiveBroker | src/broker/adaptive_broker.py | Routes tasks to best agent based on historical performance |
| PerformanceAggregator | src/broker/performance_aggregator.py | Extracts performance metrics from audit trail for routing |
| AuditClient | src/audit/client.py | Write-only HTTP audit client for emitting events |
| LocalAuditClient | src/audit/local_client.py | Local SQLite-backed audit client for development |
| AuditStore | src/audit/store.py | Append-only hash-chained audit event store |
| EnsembleBuildRunner | src/agents/ensemble_build.py | Multi-candidate blind feature build across models |
| PolyglotTDDRunner | src/agents/polyglot_tdd_runner.py | Drives TDD loop for multiple languages with efficiency comparison |
| PodFactory | src/agents/polyglot_tdd_runner.py | Creates LanguagePod instances by language identifier |
| ContextGraphRetriever | src/retrieval/cgr3_retriever.py | CGR³ pipeline: retrieve, rank, reason with context scoring |
| ContextScorer | src/retrieval/context_scorer.py | Scores bullets against request context across multiple dimensions |
| InstitutionalKnowledgeService | src/retrieval/service.py | Central knowledge retrieval service for code generation |
| LLMClient | src/utils/llm_client.py | Unified LLM client supporting multiple providers (OpenRouter, etc.) |
| EmbeddingService | src/utils/embedding.py | Local embedding generation using sentence-transformers |
| PlaybookRepository | src/storage/repository.py | PostgreSQL repository with pgvector for semantic search |
| ProjectArchitect | src/contracts/project_architect.py | Decomposes project spec into module DAG |
| ModuleArchitect | src/contracts/module_architect.py | Generates module-level contracts with integration tests |
| ModuleTDDBuilder | src/contracts/module_tdd_builder.py | Builds module implementations using TDD methodology |
| TestReviewAgent | src/agents/test_review_agent.py | Validates test quality before implementation |
| RedundancyPreChecker | src/agents/redundancy_checker.py | Pre-checks proposed tests for redundancy before RED phase |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant Orchestrator as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Reflector as Reflector
    participant Curator as Curator
    participant Audit as LocalAuditClient

    Note over Runner: Parse feature file and start loop
    loop for each iteration up to max_iterations
        Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle_number)
        activate Planner
        Planner-->>Runner: TestIncrement (spec)
        deactivate Planner

        Runner->>Cycle: run(spec)
        activate Cycle

        Note over Cycle: RED phase
        Cycle->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
        activate Worker
        Worker-->>Pod: test_code
        deactivate Worker
        Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(test_files)
        activate Orchestrator
        Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult (failing)
        deactivate Orchestrator
        Pod-->>Cycle: red_result
        deactivate Pod

        Note over Cycle: GREEN phase (with retries)
        loop for each green attempt up to max_green_attempts
            Cycle->>Pod: run_green(spec with error_feedback)
            activate Pod
            Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error_output)
            activate Worker
            Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
            deactivate Worker
            Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(test+impl files)
            activate Orchestrator
            Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult (passed or failed)
            deactivate Orchestrator
            Pod-->>Cycle: green_result
            deactivate Pod
            alt passed or abort
                break
            else
                Cycle->>Cycle: set error_feedback from output
            end
        end

        Note over Cycle: REFACTOR phase (if green passed)
        alt green_result.passed
            Cycle->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
            activate Pod
            Pod->>Worker: generate_refactor(spec, current_code)
            activate Worker
            Worker-->>Pod: refactored_code
            deactivate Worker
            Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(test+refactored files)
            activate Orchestrator
            Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
            deactivate Orchestrator
            Pod-->>Cycle: refactor_result
            deactivate Pod
        end

        Cycle->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(cycle_data)
        Cycle->>Audit: emit(TEST_GENERATED, IMPLEMENTATION_GENERATED, CYCLE_COMPLETED)

        Note over Cycle: Learning loop (if green passed or stagnant)
        opt green_result.passed or (stagnant and no abort)
            Cycle->>Reflector: reflect(task, generator_output, env_feedback)
            activate Reflector
            Reflector-->>Cycle: reflector_output
            deactivate Reflector
            Cycle->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
            activate Curator
            Curator->>Playbook: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
            activate Playbook
            Playbook-->>Curator: added_bullet_ids
            deactivate Playbook
            Curator-->>Cycle: curator_output
            deactivate Curator
            Cycle->>Audit: emit(PATTERN_LEARNED for each bullet)
        end

        Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult
        deactivate Cycle

        alt result.complete
            Note over Runner: Planner says complete
            break
        end
    end
    Note over Runner: Return IterativeResult
```
